name: player dfs ownership splits by week under a week row axis (executed-result parity)
description: Seed one player with DraftKings ownership in 2023 REG week 1 (12.50) and a different figure in week 2 (31.25), then request the column with single_nfl_week_id naming BOTH weeks under a year+week row axis. Each week row must carry its own week's ownership. Two defects made this fail together, the same pair fixed for the player game props in fc4a84ca0: get_params collapsed the week list to its FIRST element via resolve_single_nfl_week_id, so the CTE was pinned to week 1; and the attach joined on pid alone even though the CTE already projects season_year and week, so no CTE row could be selected per week even if the CTE held both. The oracle pairs the ownership WITH the week so a swap fails rather than passing on the value set alone.
expected_query:
with "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2023]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years WHERE player.primary_position IN ('MLB')), "player_years_weeks" as (SELECT player_years.pid, nfl_year_week_timestamp.year, nfl_year_week_timestamp.week FROM player_years INNER JOIN nfl_year_week_timestamp ON player_years.year = nfl_year_week_timestamp.year WHERE nfl_year_week_timestamp.year = 2023 AND nfl_year_week_timestamp.week IN (1, 2)), "tbe7f7bd8a9a6669410477d099a248275" as (
      SELECT o.pid, o.ownership_percentage, o.season_year, o.week
      FROM player_dfs_ownership o
      INNER JOIN (
        SELECT dc.source_contest_id, dc.source_id,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                 PARTITION BY dc.source_draft_group_id, dc.source_id
                 ORDER BY own_stats.nonzero_count DESC, dc.entry_count DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM dfs_contests dc
        INNER JOIN (
          SELECT source_contest_id, source_id,
                 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ownership_percentage > 0) AS nonzero_count
          FROM player_dfs_ownership
          GROUP BY source_contest_id, source_id
        ) own_stats ON own_stats.source_contest_id = dc.source_contest_id
                    AND own_stats.source_id = dc.source_id
        WHERE dc.is_ownership_imported = true
          AND dc.source_id IN ('DRAFTKINGS')
          AND ((dc.season_year = 2023 AND dc.week = 1) OR (dc.season_year = 2023 AND dc.week = 2))
      ) rc ON o.source_contest_id = rc.source_contest_id
          AND o.source_id = rc.source_id
          AND rc.rn = 1
      WHERE o.source_id IN ('DRAFTKINGS')
      ), "player_participation_weeks" as (SELECT pid, year, week, bool_or(is_active) AS is_active
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2023::int AS year, g.week, pgl.is_active
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2023 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2023) src
          GROUP BY pid, year, week), "player_years_teams" as (SELECT pid, year, array_agg(DISTINCT team_code) AS teams
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2023::int AS year, pgl.nfl_team AS team_code
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2023 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2023) src
          GROUP BY pid, year), "team_weeks_played" as (select distinct "team", "year", "week" from ((select "home_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."week" in (1, 2) and "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023)) union all (select "away_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."week" in (1, 2) and "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023))) as "g") select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "tbe7f7bd8a9a6669410477d099a248275"."ownership_percentage" AS "dfs_ownership_percentage_0", "player_years_weeks"."year", "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END AS participation_status, "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years_weeks" on "player_years_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "tbe7f7bd8a9a6669410477d099a248275" on "tbe7f7bd8a9a6669410477d099a248275"."pid" = "player"."pid" and tbe7f7bd8a9a6669410477d099a248275.season_year = player_years_weeks.year and tbe7f7bd8a9a6669410477d099a248275.week = player_years_weeks.week left join "player_participation_weeks" on "player_participation_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_participation_weeks"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" and "player_participation_weeks"."week" = "player_years_weeks"."week" left join "player_years_teams" on "player_years_teams"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_years_teams"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" where player.primary_position IN ('MLB') group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "tbe7f7bd8a9a6669410477d099a248275"."ownership_percentage", "player_years_weeks"."year", "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END, "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500
